old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-syml","title":"GCP-7.1: add replay-window bitmap to handoff confirm payload (spec amendment)","description":"Design amendment for l1qw.23.1 (lost to bd8h): the GCP-7.1 handoff confirm payload currently transfers only (link_epoch u8, link_seq u16) — but the link replay window is a 32-bit bitmap (bit 0 = last_seq, bit i = last_seq - i; lichen/subsys/lichen/link/replay.h) tracking in-window gaps the old gateway already accepted. With only the floor, the new gateway re-accepts frames in those gaps: a replay hole exactly at handoff, the attack GCP-7.1 exists to prevent. Amendment: add confirm payload key 7 = replay_bitmap (u32, bit i = link_seq - i set when that sequence was accepted), plus receiver validation step 9a (MUST reconstruct the window from epoch/seq/bitmap; MUST reject bitmap 0x00000001-with-gap... precisely: bit 0 MUST be set since link_seq itself was accepted).
